---
title: '05_decomposition'
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(furrr)
library(progressr)

rm(list = ls())
options(scipen = 999)
set.seed(123)

dir.create("outputs/figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load-data}
load("outputs/final_estimates.RData")

# 250 bootstrap draws per region
n_draws <- 250

reindex <- function(x) {
  x |>
    group_by(region, sex) |>
    mutate(bs_draw = dense_rank(bs_iteration)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(bs_draw <= n_draws) |>
    mutate(bs_iteration = bs_draw) |>
    select(-bs_draw)
}

# exclude UK (not observed in 2020-24); rows sorted by age
estimates_emp_rate <- estimates_emp_rate_bs |>
  filter(country_code_3d != "GBR") |>
  reindex() |>
  arrange(region, year_binned, sex, bs_iteration, age) |>
  select(bs_iteration, region, year_binned, sex, age, emp_rate)

estimates_hours <- estimates_hours_bs |>
  filter(country_code_3d != "GBR") |>
  reindex() |>
  arrange(region, year_binned, sex, bs_iteration, age) |>
  select(bs_iteration, region, year_binned, sex, age, hours)

stopifnot(
  n_distinct(estimates_emp_rate$region) ==
    n_distinct(estimates_emp_rate_bs$region[estimates_emp_rate_bs$country_code_3d != "GBR"]))
message("decomposing ", n_distinct(estimates_emp_rate$region), " regions")

estimates_survival <- estimates_survival |>
  filter(country_code_3d != "GBR") |>
  mutate(surv_prob = ifelse(is.na(surv_prob_regional), surv_prob_national, surv_prob_regional)) |>
  arrange(region, year_binned, sex, age) |>
  select(region, year_binned, sex, age, surv_prob)

pop_size <- estimates_combined |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(country_code_3d != "GBR") |>
  select(region, year_binned, pop_size_regional) |>
  distinct()

# lookup tables: one age vector per region, period, sex and bootstrap draw
key4 <- function(region, period, sex, draw) paste(region, period, sex, draw, sep = "\r")
key3 <- function(region, period, sex)       paste(region, period, sex, sep = "\r")

emp_lookup <- split(
  estimates_emp_rate$emp_rate,
  key4(estimates_emp_rate$region, estimates_emp_rate$year_binned,
       estimates_emp_rate$sex,    estimates_emp_rate$bs_iteration))

hours_lookup <- split(
  estimates_hours$hours,
  key4(estimates_hours$region, estimates_hours$year_binned,
       estimates_hours$sex,    estimates_hours$bs_iteration))

surv_lookup <- split(
  estimates_survival$surv_prob,
  key3(estimates_survival$region, estimates_survival$year_binned, estimates_survival$sex))

# population weights (2010-14)
pop_weight <- pop_size |> filter(year_binned == "2010-14")
pop_weight <- setNames(pop_weight$pop_size_regional, pop_weight$region)

regions  <- sort(unique(estimates_emp_rate$region))
bs_iters <- sort(unique(estimates_emp_rate$bs_iteration))

# free memory before starting the workers
rm(list = intersect(ls(), c("estimates_wle", "estimates_wle_bs",
                            "estimates_emp_rate_bs", "estimates_hours_bs",
                            "estimates_combined", "estimates_emp_rate",
                            "estimates_hours", "estimates_survival", "pop_size")))
gc()

```

```{r helper-functions}

# combinations of period 1 and period 2 components (E: employment, H: hours, S: survival)
ORDERS <- c("E1-H1-S1", "E2-H1-S1", "E1-H2-S1", "E1-H1-S2",
            "E2-H2-S1", "E1-H2-S2", "E2-H1-S2", "E2-H2-S2")

# population-weighted SD
calc_sd <- function(wle, w) {
  mu <- sum(w * wle) / sum(w)
  sqrt(sum(w * (wle - mu)^2) / sum(w))
}

# WLE for all 8 combinations, one region
permut_region <- function(reg, sex_s, bs_i, start_period, end_period) {

  E1 <- emp_lookup[[  key4(reg, start_period, sex_s, bs_i)]]
  E2 <- emp_lookup[[  key4(reg, end_period,   sex_s, bs_i)]]
  H1 <- hours_lookup[[key4(reg, start_period, sex_s, bs_i)]]
  H2 <- hours_lookup[[key4(reg, end_period,   sex_s, bs_i)]]
  S1 <- surv_lookup[[ key3(reg, start_period, sex_s)]]
  S2 <- surv_lookup[[ key3(reg, end_period,   sex_s)]]

  if (is.null(E1) || is.null(E2) || is.null(H1) || is.null(H2) ||
      is.null(S1) || is.null(S2)) return(NULL)

  c(sum(E1 * H1 * S1), sum(E2 * H1 * S1), sum(E1 * H2 * S1), sum(E1 * H1 * S2),
    sum(E2 * H2 * S1), sum(E1 * H2 * S2), sum(E2 * H1 * S2), sum(E2 * H2 * S2))
}

# stepwise replacement: contribution of E, H, and S averaged over all 6 orderings
decomp <- function(mat, w) {

  m <- function(ord) calc_sd(mat[, ord], w)

  obs_1 <- m("E1-H1-S1")
  obs_2 <- m("E2-H2-S2")

  # E contributions
  E_contrs <- c(
    m("E2-H1-S1") - obs_1,                 # E->H->S
    m("E2-H1-S1") - obs_1,                 # E->S->H
    m("E2-H2-S1") - m("E1-H2-S1"),         # H->E->S
    obs_2         - m("E1-H2-S2"),          # H->S->E
    obs_2         - m("E1-H2-S2"),          # S->H->E
    m("E2-H1-S2") - m("E1-H1-S2")          # S->E->H
  )

  # H contributions
  H_contrs <- c(
    m("E2-H2-S1") - m("E2-H1-S1"),         # E->H->S
    obs_2         - m("E2-H1-S2"),          # E->S->H
    m("E1-H2-S1") - obs_1,                 # H->E->S
    m("E1-H2-S1") - obs_1,                 # H->S->E
    m("E1-H2-S2") - m("E1-H1-S2"),         # S->H->E
    obs_2         - m("E2-H1-S2")           # S->E->H
  )

  # S contributions
  S_contrs <- c(
    obs_2         - m("E2-H2-S1"),          # E->H->S
    m("E2-H1-S2") - m("E2-H1-S1"),         # E->S->H
    obs_2         - m("E2-H2-S1"),          # H->E->S
    m("E1-H2-S2") - m("E1-H2-S1"),         # H->S->E
    m("E1-H1-S2") - obs_1,                 # S->H->E
    m("E1-H1-S2") - obs_1                  # S->E->H
  )

  E_contr    <- mean(E_contrs)
  H_contr    <- mean(H_contrs)
  S_contr    <- mean(S_contrs)
  sd_change  <- obs_2 - obs_1

  data.frame(
    ind = c("sd_start", "sd_end", "sd_change",
            "E_contr", "E_contr_perc", "H_contr", "H_contr_perc", "S_contr", "S_contr_perc"),
    value = c(
      obs_1, obs_2, sd_change,
      E_contr, E_contr / sd_change * 100,
      H_contr, H_contr / sd_change * 100,
      S_contr, S_contr / sd_change * 100
    )
  )
}
```

```{r decomposition-loop}
periods <- c("2000-04", "2005-09", "2010-14", "2015-19", "2020-24")

# all combinations of period, sex and bootstrap draw
grid <- expand.grid(
  end_period = periods[-1],          # "2005-09" through "2020-24"
  sex        = c("female", "male"),
  bs_i       = bs_iters,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(start_period = periods[match(end_period, periods) - 1])

options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)

# number of workers (about 0.5 GB of memory each)
n_workers <- 50
allocated <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK")))
if (!is.na(allocated)) n_workers <- min(n_workers, allocated)
n_workers <- min(n_workers, parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE), na.rm = TRUE)

message("using ", n_workers, " workers for ", nrow(grid), " tasks")
plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

handlers(handler_progress(
  format = "[:bar] :current/:total | :message",
  width  = 80
))

with_progress({

  p <- progressor(nrow(grid))

  decomp_results_bs <- future_pmap_dfr(
    grid,
    function(end_period, sex, bs_i, start_period) {

      p(message = sprintf("%s -> %s | %s | bs %s", start_period, end_period, sex, bs_i))

      # regions x 8 matrix
      vals <- lapply(regions, permut_region,
                     sex_s        = sex,
                     bs_i         = bs_i,
                     start_period = start_period,
                     end_period   = end_period)

      ok   <- !vapply(vals, is.null, logical(1))
      w    <- pop_weight[regions[ok]]
      ok2  <- !is.na(w)

      mat  <- do.call(rbind, vals[ok][ok2])
      colnames(mat) <- ORDERS

      result              <- decomp(mat, w[ok2])
      result$bs_iteration <- bs_i
      result$sex          <- sex
      result$period       <- end_period
      result
    },
    .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  )

})

plan(sequential)
```

```{r summarise-results}
decomp_results <- decomp_results_bs |>
  group_by(ind, sex, period) |>
  summarise(
    est = mean(value,                   na.rm = TRUE),
    low = quantile(value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    upp = quantile(value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  select(sex, period, ind, est, low, upp)
```

```{r plot-decomp}
plot_data <- decomp_results |>
  filter(ind %in% c("E_contr", "H_contr", "S_contr")) |>
  mutate(
    ind = factor(ind,
                 levels = c("S_contr", "H_contr", "E_contr"),
                 labels = c("Survival", "Working hours", "Employment participation")),
    sex = ifelse(sex == "male", "Men", "Women"),
    period = case_when(
      period == "2005-09" ~ "2000-04 to\n2005-09",
      period == "2010-14" ~ "2005-09 to\n2010-14",
      period == "2015-19" ~ "2010-14 to\n2015-19",
      period == "2020-24" ~ "2015-19 to\n2020-24",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = ind, y = est, fill = ind)) +
  facet_grid(period ~ sex, switch = "y") +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = upp, ymin = low), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 10, 0.05)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("goldenrod", "firebrick", "navyblue")) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    axis.ticks.y     = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y      = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 14)
  ) +
  labs(
    x    = NULL,
    y    = "Contribution to Change in Standard Deviation",
    fill = "Component"
  )
ggsave("outputs/figures/fig5_decomp.pdf", width = 6.5, height = 7)
ggsave("outputs/figures/fig5_decomp.png", width = 6.5, height = 5.5)
```
